items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I was doing some stuff with Sid Weiss and Dorsey Terry. We were doing some rock and roll things for different publishers

ctx.x: I was supposed to go into NBC with John Hammond. He was trying to get me -- Remember, I was still -- When I came back, I went back into writing, because I start to writing, I think, with Charlie Singleton at that time. I was doing some stuff with Sid Weiss and Dorsey Terry. We were doing some rock and roll things for different publishers, and things like that.
Was this rock and roll you're talking about in the 40's now?
